items.stem: Explain why the equation z² − 6z + 28 = 0 has no real roots, and find its roots, commenting on how they are related.

items.stem: Explain why complex numbers simplify the addition of two sinusoidal voltages of the same frequency.
items.answer: Each sinusoid A cos(ωt + φ) is the real part of Ae^(iφ)e^(iωt); adding them only requires adding the phasors Ae^(iφ), a single complex addition, then reading off the modulus (amplitude) and argument (phase).
